title: Chapter3
description: Finnish vocabulary: daily life, food, places and everyday verbs

questions.question: Morning
questions.explanation: 'Aamu' means morning.

questions.question: Breakfast
questions.explanation: 'Aamupala' means breakfast, literally 'morning bite'.
questions.exampletranslate: I eat breakfast at seven o'clock.

questions.question: Early
questions.explanation: 'Aikaisin' means early.
questions.exampletranslate: I wake up early in the morning.

questions.question: Adult
questions.explanation: 'Aikuinen' means adult; its genitive is 'aikuisen'.

questions.question: Help / Assistance
questions.explanation: 'Apu' means help or assistance; its genitive is 'avun'.

questions.question: Weekday
questions.explanation: 'Arkipäivä' means weekday (an ordinary working day).
questions.exampletranslate: On a weekday I go to work.

questions.question: Thing / Matter
questions.explanation: 'Asia' means thing or matter (an abstract issue).

questions.question: Open
questions.explanation: 'Auki' means open (e.g. a shop that is open).

questions.question: Opening hours
questions.explanation: 'Aukioloajat' means opening hours; its genitive is 'aukioloaikojen'.
questions.exampletranslate: What are the shop's opening hours?

questions.question: To open / unlock
questions.explanation: 'Avata' (type 4 verb) means to open or unlock; 'avaan' is 'I open'.

questions.question: Banana
questions.explanation: 'Banaani' means banana.

questions.question: Bus
questions.explanation: 'Bussi' means bus.
questions.exampletranslate: I go to work by bus.

questions.question: First / Initially
questions.explanation: 'Ensin' means first or at first.
questions.exampletranslate: First I eat, then I go out.

questions.question: Person
questions.explanation: 'Henkilö' means person (often in a formal or official sense).

questions.question: To wake up
questions.explanation: 'Herätä' (type 4 verb) means to wake up; 'herään' is 'I wake up'.
questions.exampletranslate: I wake up at six o'clock.

questions.question: Just a minute / A moment
questions.explanation: 'Hetkinen' means just a minute or a moment; its genitive is 'hetkisen'.
questions.exampletranslate: Just a minute, I'm coming soon!

questions.question: To take care of
questions.explanation: 'Hoitaa' (type 1 verb) means to take care of; 'hoidan' is 'I take care of'.
questions.exampletranslate: I take care of the children at home.

questions.question: Well
questions.explanation: 'Hyvin' means well (the adverb of 'hyvä').

questions.question: Person / Human
questions.explanation: 'Ihminen' means person or human being; its genitive is 'ihmisen'.

questions.question: Evening
questions.explanation: 'Ilta' means evening; its genitive is 'illan'.
questions.exampletranslate: In the evening I watch television.

questions.question: To sit
questions.explanation: 'Istua' (type 1 verb) means to sit; 'istun' is 'I sit'.

questions.question: Yogurt
questions.explanation: 'Jugurtti' means yogurt; its genitive is 'jugurtin'.

questions.question: To drink
questions.explanation: 'Juoda' (type 2 verb) means to drink; 'juon' is 'I drink'.

questions.question: To chat / talk
questions.explanation: 'Jutella' (type 3 verb) means to chat or talk; 'juttelen' is 'I chat'.

questions.question: Ice hockey
questions.explanation: 'Jääkiekko' means ice hockey, from 'jää' (ice) and 'kiekko' (puck); its genitive is 'jääkiekon'.

questions.question: Hairdresser's (salon)
questions.explanation: 'Kampaamo' means a hairdresser's salon.
questions.exampletranslate: I am going to the hairdresser's.

questions.question: With
questions.explanation: 'Kanssa' means with (together with someone).

questions.question: Shop / Store
questions.explanation: 'Kauppa' means shop or store; its genitive is 'kaupan'.
questions.exampletranslate: I go to the shop to buy food.

questions.question: Buddy / Friend (informal)
questions.explanation: 'Kaveri' means buddy, mate or friend (informal).

questions.question: Kitchen
questions.explanation: 'Keittiö' means kitchen.
questions.exampletranslate: The food is in the kitchen.

questions.question: To boil / cook
questions.explanation: 'Keittää' (type 1 verb) means to boil or cook; 'keitän' is 'I boil/cook'.

questions.question: Discussion / Conversation
questions.explanation: 'Keskustelu' means discussion or conversation.

questions.question: Summer
questions.explanation: 'Kesä' means summer.

questions.question: Forbidden
questions.explanation: 'Kielletty' means forbidden; its genitive is 'kielletyn'.

questions.question: Closed
questions.explanation: 'Kiinni' means closed (e.g. a shop that is shut).

questions.question: Hurry
questions.explanation: 'Kiire' means hurry or rush; its genitive is 'kiireen'.

questions.question: Kiosk
questions.explanation: 'Kioski' means kiosk.
questions.exampletranslate: I buy a magazine from the kiosk.

questions.question: Library
questions.explanation: 'Kirjasto' means library.

questions.question: Because
questions.explanation: 'Koska' means because.
questions.exampletranslate: I am at home because I am sick.

questions.question: Pupil / Schoolchild
questions.explanation: 'Koululainen' means a pupil or schoolchild; its genitive is 'koululaisen'.

questions.question: Than
questions.explanation: 'Kuin' means than (used in comparisons).

questions.question: Dead
questions.explanation: 'Kuollut' means dead; its genitive is 'kuolleen'.

questions.question: Sign / Plate
questions.explanation: 'Kyltti' means sign or plate; its genitive is 'kyltin'.

questions.question: To ask
questions.explanation: 'Kysyä' (type 1 verb) means to ask; 'kysyn' is 'I ask'.

questions.question: To go / visit
questions.explanation: 'Käydä' (type 2 verb) means to go or visit somewhere; 'käyn' is 'I go/visit', used with 'missä'.

questions.question: Lawyer
questions.explanation: 'Lakimies' means lawyer; its genitive is 'lakimiehen'.

questions.question: Kindergarten teacher
questions.explanation: 'Lastentarhanopettaja' means kindergarten teacher.
questions.exampletranslate: The kindergarten teacher works at the daycare.

questions.question: To sing
questions.explanation: 'Laulaa' (type 1 verb) means to sing; 'laulan' is 'I sing'.

questions.question: Leaf / Magazine
questions.explanation: 'Lehti' means leaf or magazine/newspaper; its genitive is 'lehden'.
questions.exampletranslate: I read the magazine in the morning.

questions.question: To play (children, fun)
questions.explanation: 'Leikkiä' (type 1 verb) means to play (used for free, imaginative children's play); 'leikin' is 'I play'.
questions.exampletranslate: The children play in the yard.

questions.question: To bake
questions.explanation: 'Leipoa' (type 1 verb) means to bake; 'leivon' is 'I bake'.

questions.question: Bread
questions.explanation: 'Leipä' means bread; its genitive is 'leivän'.

questions.question: End / Finish
questions.explanation: 'Loppu' means end or finish; its genitive is 'lopun'.
questions.exampletranslate: This is the end of the story.

questions.question: Lunch
questions.explanation: 'Lounas' means lunch; its genitive is 'lounaan'.
questions.exampletranslate: I eat lunch at twelve o'clock.

questions.question: To read
questions.explanation: 'Lukea' (type 1 verb) means to read; 'luen' is 'I read'.

questions.question: To leave / go
questions.explanation: 'Lähteä' (type 1 verb) means to leave or set off; 'lähden' is 'I leave'.

questions.question: Milk
questions.explanation: 'Maito' means milk; its genitive is 'maidon'.
questions.exampletranslate: I drink a glass of milk.

questions.question: Macaroni casserole
questions.explanation: 'Makaronilaatikko' is a Finnish macaroni casserole; its genitive is 'makaronilaatikon'.

questions.question: Math
questions.explanation: 'Matematiikka' means mathematics; its genitive is 'matematiikan'.

questions.question: To put on make-up
questions.explanation: 'Meikata' (type 4 verb) means to put on make-up; 'meikkaan' is 'I put on make-up'.
questions.exampletranslate: I put on make-up before the party.

questions.question: Music
questions.explanation: 'Musiikki' means music; its genitive is 'musiikin'.

questions.question: But
questions.explanation: 'Mutta' means but.
questions.example: Haluan tulla, mutta minulla on kiire.
questions.exampletranslate: I want to come, but I am in a hurry.

questions.question: Late
questions.explanation: 'Myöhään' means late.

questions.question: To laugh
questions.explanation: 'Nauraa' (type 1 verb) means to laugh; 'nauran' is 'I laugh'.

questions.question: To rise / get up / increase
questions.explanation: 'Nousta' (type 1 verb) means to rise, get up or increase; 'nousen' is 'I rise'.
questions.exampletranslate: I get up from bed in the morning.

questions.question: To sleep
questions.explanation: 'Nukkua' (type 1 verb) means to sleep; 'nukun' is 'I sleep'.

questions.question: Student
questions.explanation: 'Opiskelija' means student.

questions.question: To take
questions.explanation: 'Ottaa' (type 1 verb) means to take; 'otan' is 'I take'.

questions.question: Door
questions.explanation: 'Ovi' means door; its genitive is 'oven'.

questions.question: To serve
questions.explanation: 'Palvella' (type 3 verb) means to serve; 'palvelen' is 'I serve'.
questions.exampletranslate: I serve customers at the shop.

questions.question: Couple / Pair
questions.explanation: 'Pari' means couple or pair.

questions.question: Parking garage
questions.explanation: 'Parkkihalli' means parking garage.
questions.exampletranslate: I leave the car in the parking garage.

questions.question: Barber
questions.explanation: 'Parturi' means barber.
questions.exampletranslate: I am going to the barber.

questions.question: To play (games, sport)
questions.explanation: 'Pelata' (type 4 verb) means to play games or sports; 'pelaan' is 'I play'.

questions.question: To wash
questions.explanation: 'Pestä' (type 3 verb) means to wash; 'pesen' is 'I wash'.

questions.question: Laundry (place / launderette)
questions.explanation: 'Pesula' means a laundry or launderette (the place).
questions.exampletranslate: I take the clothes to the laundry.

questions.question: For a long time
questions.explanation: 'Pitkään' means for a long time.
questions.exampletranslate: I waited for a long time.

questions.question: To burn
questions.explanation: 'Polttaa' (type 1 verb) means to burn (also to smoke); 'poltan' is 'I burn'.

questions.question: Post / Mail
questions.explanation: 'Posti' means post or mail.
questions.exampletranslate: I take the letter to the post office.

questions.question: Chewing gum
questions.explanation: 'Purukumi' means chewing gum.

questions.question: To park
questions.explanation: 'Pysäköidä' (type 2 verb) means to park; 'pysäköin' is 'I park'.

questions.question: Laundry (clothes to be washed)
questions.explanation: 'Pyykki' means laundry (the clothes/washing); its genitive is 'pyykin'.

questions.question: Day
questions.explanation: 'Päivä' means day.

questions.question: Nursery / Daycare
questions.explanation: 'Päiväkoti' means nursery or daycare; its genitive is 'päiväkodin'.

questions.question: To love
questions.explanation: 'Rakastaa' (type 1 verb) means to love; 'rakastan' is 'I love'.

questions.question: Restaurant
questions.explanation: 'Ravintola' means restaurant.

questions.question: Prescription / Recipe
questions.explanation: 'Resepti' means a prescription (medical) or a recipe (cooking).

questions.question: Food
questions.explanation: 'Ruoka' means food; its genitive is 'ruoan' (also 'ruuan').

questions.question: Salty licorice
questions.explanation: 'Salmiakki' is salty licorice, a popular Finnish candy; its genitive is 'salmiakin'.

questions.question: To clean / clean up
questions.explanation: 'Siivota' (type 4 verb) means to clean or clean up; 'siivoan' is 'I clean'.
questions.exampletranslate: I clean the home on Saturday.

questions.question: Therefore
questions.explanation: 'Siksi' means therefore or that's why.
questions.exampletranslate: I am tired, therefore I go to sleep.

questions.question: Then / After that
questions.explanation: 'Sitten' means then or after that.
questions.exampletranslate: First I eat, then I rest.

questions.question: Sofa / Couch
questions.explanation: 'Sohva' means sofa or couch.
questions.exampletranslate: I sit on the sofa and watch a movie.

questions.question: To call / play (an instrument)
questions.explanation: 'Soittaa' (type 1 verb) means to call (by phone) or to play an instrument; 'soitan' is 'I call/play'.
questions.exampletranslate: I'll call you in the evening.

questions.question: To suit / fit / agree
questions.explanation: 'Sopia' (type 1 verb) means to suit, fit or agree; 'sovin' is 'I agree/it fits'.

questions.question: Shower
questions.explanation: 'Suihku' means shower.
questions.exampletranslate: I take a shower in the morning.

questions.question: Closed (e.g. shut for business)
questions.explanation: 'Suljettu' means closed (formal, e.g. on a sign); its genitive is 'suljetun'.
questions.exampletranslate: The shop is closed on Sunday.

questions.question: To eat
questions.explanation: 'Syödä' (type 2 verb) means to eat; 'syön' is 'I eat'.

questions.question: To happen / occur
questions.explanation: 'Tapahtua' (type 1 verb) means to happen or occur; 'se tapahtuu' is 'it happens'.

questions.question: Offer
questions.explanation: 'Tarjous' means offer or special deal; its genitive is 'tarjouksen'.

questions.question: To need / require
questions.explanation: 'Tarvita' (type 5 verb) means to need or require; 'tarvitsen' is 'I need'.

questions.question: Usual / Ordinary
questions.explanation: 'Tavallinen' means usual or ordinary; its genitive is 'tavallisen'.

questions.question: Goods / Stuff
questions.explanation: 'Tavara' means goods, stuff or an item.
questions.exampletranslate: There is a lot of stuff in the shop.

questions.question: To meet
questions.explanation: 'Tavata' (type 4 verb) means to meet; 'tapaan' is 'I meet'.
questions.exampletranslate: I meet my friend at the café.

questions.question: Tennis
questions.explanation: 'Tennis' means tennis; its genitive is 'tenniksen'.

questions.question: Thermos
questions.explanation: 'Termospullo' means a thermos flask.
questions.exampletranslate: The coffee is in the thermos.

questions.question: Computer
questions.explanation: 'Tietokone' means computer; its genitive is 'tietokoneen'.

questions.question: Very / True
questions.explanation: 'Tosi' means very (colloquial) or true; its genitive is 'toden'.

questions.question: Match (for lighting fire)
questions.explanation: 'Tulitikku' means a match; its genitive plural is 'tulitikkujen'.

questions.question: To come / become
questions.explanation: 'Tulla' (type 3 verb) means to come or become; 'tulen' is 'I come'.
questions.exampletranslate: I'll come home in the evening.

questions.question: Tobacco
questions.explanation: 'Tupakka' means tobacco (or a cigarette); its genitive is 'tupakan'.

questions.question: To smoke
questions.explanation: 'Tupakoida' (type 2 verb) means to smoke; 'tupakoin' is 'I smoke'.

questions.question: Known / Familiar
questions.explanation: 'Tuttu' means known or familiar; its genitive is 'tutun'.
questions.exampletranslate: This place is familiar to me.

questions.question: Workday
questions.explanation: 'Työpäivä' means workday.

questions.question: At work
questions.explanation: 'Töissä' means at work (from 'työ'); 'käy töissä' means 'goes to work'.

questions.question: Outside
questions.explanation: 'Ulkona' means outside (being outdoors).

questions.question: Exit / Out
questions.explanation: 'Ulos' means out or exit (going outwards).

questions.question: Holiday / Day off
questions.explanation: 'Vapaapäivä' means a holiday or day off.

questions.question: To reserve / book
questions.explanation: 'Varata' (type 4 verb) means to reserve or book; 'varaan' is 'I reserve'.
questions.exampletranslate: I reserve a table at the restaurant.

questions.question: Reserved
questions.explanation: 'Varattu' means reserved or taken/busy; its genitive is 'varatun'.

questions.question: To take out
questions.explanation: 'Viedä' (type 2 verb) means to take (somewhere) or take out; 'vien' is 'I take'.

questions.question: Message
questions.explanation: 'Viesti' means message.
questions.exampletranslate: I got a message from you.

questions.question: Weekend
questions.explanation: 'Viikonloppu' means weekend, from 'viikko' (week) and 'loppu' (end); its genitive is 'viikonlopun'.

questions.question: Wine
questions.explanation: 'Viini' means wine.
questions.exampletranslate: I drink a glass of wine.

questions.question: Can / To be able to
questions.explanation: 'Voida' (type 2 verb) means can or to be able to; 'voin' is 'I can'.

questions.question: Snack
questions.explanation: 'Välipala' means snack (a bite between meals).
questions.exampletranslate: I eat a snack in the afternoon.

questions.question: Tired
questions.explanation: 'Väsynyt' means tired; its genitive is 'väsyneen'.
